us_halal.summary: US equities ~2% off early-October records as the Fed hikes (3.75-4.00%, more priced by Dec) against 3.7% CPI and ~5% 10y yields. Broad Shariah ETFs (SPUS core, UMMA diversifier) bought monthly; single stocks only as small fractional satellites; avoid MSFT (not halal per Musaffa) and GOOGL (doubtful).

crypto_spot.summary: BTC trades near $80.5k, about 36% below its Oct 2025 all-time high, in a choppy recovery after a June low near $58k, with a hawkish Fed, 5% US yields and stalled US market-structure legislation as headwinds. Small fixed-schedule DCA in BTC and ETH; optional small SOL/XRP/XLM/ADA. Avoid BNB, meme coins, DeFi-lending tokens, Earn/staking yield, idle USDT.

commodities.summary: Gold (~$4,013) is in a corrective downtrend ~28% below its January 2026 record, testing $4,000 under Fed-hike pressure; silver (~$53.7) is below its 200-day. Accumulate certified physically-backed gold (RMAU first; GLD, Albilad 9405 alternatives); hold off silver. Avoid futures-based ETFs; uncertified physical funds (AAAU, IAU, SLV) need a scholar's approval.

msx.summary: MSX publishes an AAOIFI-based Sharia list (35 firms, ~RO 8bn, Sep 2026) and a 15-stock Shariah Index (608.95 on 22-Oct, ~+16% YTD after a ~5% October pullback). Core: Bank Nizwa, OQ Gas Networks, OQEP, Abraj. Conventional banks and Omantel fail the screen. Add steadily, not lump-sum.
